entries.title: Gas Atoms in a Box with Dynamic Bond Formation
entries.description: A set of colored spheres representing different atom types bounce inside a transparent box, occasionally colliding and forming or breaking glowing cylindrical “bonds” depending on speed and distance, with labels and short-lived particle bursts at each bond event.

entries.title: Molecular Lattice Stretch and Break
entries.description: A 3D grid of atoms connected by spring-like bonds is slowly stretched by two transparent plates pulling opposite sides, showing bonds thinning, vibrating, snapping, and re-forming, with stress shown by bond color from blue (low) to red (high).

entries.title: Crystallization from a Cooling Gas
entries.description: Free atoms drift randomly in a light-colored volume and, as a “temperature” slider is lowered, they begin to stick and align into a growing crystalline cluster, with new arrivals snapping into place and giving off small spark-like particles.

entries.title: Ionic Bonding Between Two Charged Clouds
entries.description: Red positively charged ions and blue negatively charged ions float in separate transparent regions, then the barrier is removed so they accelerate toward each other, pair up into neutral units with bright links, and arrange into a simple ionic crystal.

entries.title: Covalent Bond Angle and Rotation Explorer
entries.description: A central atom with multiple bonded neighbors is shown with adjustable bond angles and torsions controlled by sliders, causing the bonded atoms to smoothly rotate around bonds while bond angle markers and labels update in real time.

entries.title: Simple Molecule Builder with Snap-to-Bond Sites
entries.description: Loose atoms of several types float gently until the user drags and drops them near a central structure, where they snap into discrete bonding positions, change color to indicate bond type, and display bond order labels and short-lived trails.

entries.title: Vibrating Diatomic Molecule Gas

Here are strong **Atoms and bonding simulation inputs** you can plug into your prompt:

1. **Gas Atoms in a Box with Dynamic Bond Formation**

   A 3D grid of atoms connected by spring-like bonds is slowly stretched by two transparent plates pulling opposite sides, showing bonds thinning, vibrating, snapping, and re-forming, with stress shown by bond color from blue (low) to red (high).

4. **Ionic Bonding Between Two Charged Clouds**
   Red positively charged ions and blue negatively charged ions float in separate transparent regions, then the barrier is removed so they accelerate toward each other, pair up into neutral units with bright links, and arrange into a simple ionic crystal.

5. **Covalent Bond Angle and Rotation Explorer**
   A central atom with multiple bonded neighbors is shown with adjustable bond angles and torsions controlled by sliders, causing the bonded atoms to smoothly rotate around bonds while bond angle markers and labels update in real time.
